must_identify.item: The pod is Pending with FailedScheduling Insufficient cpu
must_identify.evidence: Error: 0/3 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint(s), 2 Insufficient cpu.

must_identify.item: The cause is the 64-core CPU request, above any node's allocatable CPU
must_identify.evidence: Solution: 1) Add tolerations to pod for tainted node 2) Reduce pod CPU requests 3) Add nodes to cluster 4) Remove unused pods to free CPU

wrong_answers_asserted: Adding nodes as the primary fix without noting the request is the error
notes: The RCA never mentions the 64-core request. It frames the problem as nodes lacking CPU plus a taint, and makes adding tolerations the first fix. 'Reduce pod CPU requests' appears only as one hedged option among four, with no target value such as 50m. A reviewer may consider fix_acceptable borderline, since the correct fix is listed but not prioritized.
